purpose: Recognize a project deployment workflow from scripts, CI, and smoke verification without writing deployment infrastructure.

evidence.fact: The package declares a staging deployment script.
evidence.observation: deploy:staging script is invoked as npm run deploy:staging and runs bash scripts/deploy-staging.sh
evidence.whyItMatters: A named deployment task is a trigger for a bounded workflow search.

evidence.fact: The deployment runbook declares build, staging deploy, and smoke verification in order.
evidence.observation: workflow is npm run build && npm run deploy:staging && npm run smoke:staging
evidence.whyItMatters: Deployment requires an ordered project procedure and a completion check.

evidence.fact: CI corroborates the documented staging deployment workflow.
evidence.observation: CI runs npm run build && npm run deploy:staging && npm run smoke:staging
evidence.whyItMatters: Independent CI evidence confirms the exact command sequence without authorizing CI edits.

evidence.fact: The smoke script checks the staging health endpoint.
evidence.observation: smoke-staging requests /health and fails when the HTTP response is not successful
evidence.whyItMatters: The post-deploy verification is an observable completion criterion.

facts.value: npm run build && npm run deploy:staging && npm run smoke:staging

skillDecisions.name: deployment
skillDecisions.reason: Scripts, independent CI/runbook evidence, and a staging smoke check establish a repeated deployment workflow.

targetedFollowUpSearch.result: Cross-checking scripts, runbook, CI, and smoke code found one exact staging workflow with an observable health check.

taskTriggers: deploying the application to the documented staging environment
whenNotToUse: production release or infrastructure changes without an approved production procedure
workflowSteps: Run the project build before invoking the staging deployment script.
Run the documented staging deployment command.
Run the staging smoke check and inspect the health result before reporting completion.
